name: Thresher Eye
summary: Thresher Eyes are organic harvesting samples taken from the threshers prowling the coastal waters of Darkshore. They are sought by the eccentric gnome engineer Wizbang Cranktoggle to service his automated field devices known as Buzzboxes.

sections.title: Ecological Samples for Gnomish Gadgets
sections.body: Off the misty shores of Darkshore, aquatic predators known as Darkshore Threshers hunt along the surf and outer shallows. While dangerous to local fishermen and travelers, these beasts possess large ocular organs that have drawn the peculiar interest of Wizbang Cranktoggle. Stationed nearby and deeply fond of crawler wine, the gnomish engineer demands these eyes as essential components to repair Buzzbox 411, an automated surveying machine positioned along the northern beaches.

sections.title: The Purpose of the Eyes
sections.body: Wizbang never fully elaborates on how slimy sea-creature eyes repair delicate mechanical apparatuses, whether functioning as crude optical lenses, chemical agents, or esoteric biological gears. Regardless of the questionable engineering logic, feeding three of these harvested eyes into Buzzbox 411's maintenance hatch successfully restores the machine's comms link, allowing Wizbang to dispense rewards through static-choked transmissions.

faq.q: Where do Thresher Eyes come from?
faq.answer: Thresher Eyes are harvested from Darkshore Threshers and Elder Darkshore Threshers swimming in the ocean waters off the coast of Darkshore, particularly near Auberdine.

faq.q: Why does Wizbang Cranktoggle want Thresher Eyes?
faq.answer: Wizbang claims the eyes are needed to repair Buzzbox 411, a gnomish contraption located north of Auberdine on the shoreline. Inserting them into the machine's hatch reactivates its systems.

faq.q: How does an eye fix a machine?
faq.answer: Gnomish engineering often defies conventional logic, especially when guided by Wizbang Cranktoggle's inebriated schemes. Whether he uses the retinas for optical focusing or simply incorporates organic parts into his eccentric designs, the device accepts them and powers back on.

Buzzbox 411 is one of several communication and monitoring devices deployed across Darkshore by Wizbang Cranktoggle. Once loaded with requested materials, it allows Wizbang to communicate remotely and dispense supplies.

angles.text: Wizbang's reliance on raw animal parts to mend complex mechanical relays offers a baffling, albeit humorous, study in unorthodox gnomish contraptions.
Wizbang Cranktoggle represents the wilder fringes of gnomish ingenuity, tinkering with field machinery along Kalimdor's wilderness between cups of crawler wine.
